pocket.name: The mobile N-terminal HVEM-binding hairpin of gD, narrowed to the...
pocket.why_this_rank: C5 is a genuine mapped linear neutralizing site and is compact with plausible charge complementarity, but its strongly polar/basic composition is a poorer whole-paratope match and it requires a dynamic linear-site binding mode not shown for HAB194.
pocket.rests_on: HAB194 can recognize the mobile N-terminal segment as a linear or induced-fit epitope despite low exposure of two proposed hydrophobic contacts.
pocket.what_it_is: The mobile N-terminal HVEM-binding hairpin of gD, narrowed to the exposed linear 10–21 ridge that lies within the receptor-forming N terminus and corresponds to a known group-VII/1D3 neutralizing antigenic site.
pocket.why_one_candidate: not pooled with anything: no other patch is both within 12 A (half centroid distance, half contact-graph hops) and coverable by one paratope of this antibody's reach, 17.7 A

note: `confidence` on the pocket is over pockets and sums to about 1 across them. Inside an interface it is per residue in [0, 1] and sums to nothing. No residue is cut at a threshold: the whole vector is the answer.

paratope.heavy_light_split: Approximately 65:35 heavy:light. H3/H2/H1 cover C:10–18 and the central hairpin turn; both chains converge across C:14–18, while L1/L3 finish the C:19–21 flank.

pooling_provenance.note: counts only, describing how the organizer grouped the phase-1 patches. The organizer's own candidate residue list is deliberately absent: the answer is the advocate's footprint, in `residues` and in `antibodies[].interfaces[]`.

advocate.weakest_point: This is a highly dynamic terminus, and two visually central hydrophobic residues, C:12 and C:17, are poorly exposed in the supplied apo conformation. Without peptide binding or 1D3/HVEM competition, there is no evidence that HAB194 is a linear-site antibody rather than a conformational-site antibody elsewhere.
advocate.note: the advocate reports claim/source/date/bearing and is not asked whether a source is about this binder

judge.note: Tier A -- a source about this binder itself -- is the judge's adjudication, in assessment[].support[]. It exists nowhere in the advocate's own answer.
